exact_statement: For every five-tuple A_i in Q^{dxd}, let m=d+1, E=[e_1-e_m,...,e_d-e_m], F=[I_d 0]-(1/m)1_d1_m^T, J=1_m1_m^T/m, K=1+max_i{||A_i||_{entry-1},||EA_iF||_{entry-1}}, t=1/(64mK), and P_i=J+E((1/2)I_d+tA_i)F. Then P_i is a strictly positive doubly stochastic m-by-m matrix with every entry >31/(64m); S=[1_m E] gives S^{-1}P_iS=diag(1,(1/2)I_d+tA_i), and A_i=t^{-1}(FP_iE-(1/2)I_d). For Phi=s4(X_1,...,X_4)(I+X_5)^{-1}, every inverse gate remains defined and S^{-1}Phi(P)S=diag(0,t^4s4(A_1,...,A_4)((3/2)I_d+tA_5)^{-1}). Hence every source hit with invertible Phi(A) produces a nonzero direct stochastic-kernel output. These P_i are also time-one kernels of dense positive CTMC generators log(P_i).
assumptions: All A_i are finite rational square matrices of the same dimension d.
The target rational formula is the stated s4 formula with its only inverse node (I+X_5)^{-1}.
For the N51 consequence, the selected integer tuple is a hit with invertible Phi(A), as claimed by the source interface; source correctness remains externally unverified.
For the CTMC statement, controls can in principle realize independently programmed dense generators and the model remains homogeneous during a unit-duration pulse.
status: internally reconstructed exact construction; one finite fixture exact-checked; physical control conditional
novelty_boundary: The construction is a direct internal derivation and is not priority-cleared. Amitsur-Levitzki, the N51 candidate, and Markov embeddability are prior art. No molecule is shown to implement the controls, and the N51 source generator is not externally verified.
costs: Exact rational work uses polynomial bit complexity in d and total input bit length L; five dense kernels contain 5(d+1)^2 entries. A conditional pulse implementation has 5(d+1)d off-diagonal rate channels and full transition readout requires 5(d+1)^2 start/end probabilities; direct s4 sequence measurement uses up to 24(d+1)^2 conditions before replicates.
falsifier: An exact rational counterexample to any displayed identity, positivity bound, or inverse-domain statement would refute the construction. For physical transfer, failure to implement/calibrate the five dense generators and to resolve the frozen nonzero output margin on held-out data refutes the proposed assay bridge for that tuple.
next_gate: Independently execute or verify an actual nontrivial N51 list instance, publish the selected tuple and its exact P_i, then test whether a measured pathway can realize the dense controls and transition readout within the computed precision budget.

exact_statement: Let H=max_{i,a,b}|(A_i)_{ab}|. The construction has K<=1+4d^4H and t>=1/[64(d+1)(1+4d^4H)]. For an integer N51 hit with s4(A) invertible, the lower zero-sum block Y of Phi(P) satisfies ||Y||_2>t^4/(2sqrt(d)). Thus the construction yields O(L+log d) bits of guaranteed raw signal precision when H<=2^L, but can require inverse-square endpoint-sampling cost t^{-8}poly(d), exponential in L. N51's polynomial entry-bit bound supplies no inverse-polynomial-in-input-size experimental margin, selected moderate-height hit, control encoding, or measured condition number. This is a worst-case interface limitation, not a claim that every source tuple has tiny signal.
assumptions: The N51 tuple entries are integers for the stated s4 norm lower bound.
An endpoint assay estimates bounded-variance transition probabilities and reads the direct signed formula output, rather than having exact rational entries supplied digitally.
N51 provides polynomial entry bit lengths but no stronger height or robustness guarantee in its stated interface.
status: derived analytic scale bound; actual N51 list-member heights and physical assay performance remain unmeasured
novelty_boundary: The scale conclusion follows from the explicit embedding and the source's stated bit-cost interface. It does not refute the abstract hitting-list theorem or assert an actual wet-lab failure.
costs: With entry magnitude H, t is inverse polynomial in H and d. For H exponential in L, t can be exponentially small in L; direct output suppression is t^4 and endpoint sampling scales as the inverse square of target precision. Exact digital evaluation avoids measurement only when the tuple and coefficients are already acquired, in which case the assay contributes no new model information.
falsifier: A source-level guarantee that every relevant selected hit has polynomial numerical height and a polynomial singular-value/output margin, or a validated equal-budget physical assay attaining the frozen precision, would remove this practical-margin objection for that restricted family.
next_gate: Materialize a specific N51 hit for a named formula and report H, t, inverse-node condition numbers, propagated output margin, actuator/readout map, and measured endpoint sample count before making a physical-use claim.
